description: A shell script for building, configuring, and testing an OpenClaw onboarding process using Docker, including various test cases for local and remote configurations, reset, channels, and skills flows.

methods.name: start_gateway
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw gateway server as a background process on localhost with specified port and bind address.

methods.name: wait_for_gateway
methods.description: Waits until the gateway server is listening on the specified port by attempting TCP connections.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the gateway server process given its PID.

methods.name: run_wizard_cmd
methods.description: Runs a wizard command in an isolated environment, managing input/output and optional gateway startup.

methods.name: run_wizard
methods.description: A wrapper to run the onboarding wizard with default settings.

methods.name: make_home
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory to serve as a workspace for a given test case.

methods.name: set_isolated_openclaw_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to isolate OpenClaw configuration for a specific test case.

methods.name: assert_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at a given path, otherwise exits.

methods.name: assert_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at a given path, otherwise exits.

methods.name: select_skip_hooks
methods.description: Automates the selection of 'Skip for now' during wizard hooks.

methods.name: send_local_basic
methods.description: Automates the flow for a basic local onboarding.

methods.name: send_reset_config_only
methods.description: Automates the flow for resetting configuration during onboarding.

methods.name: send_channels_flow
methods.description: Automates the configuration of communication channels.

methods.name: send_skills_flow
methods.description: Automates the configuration of skills settings.

methods.name: run_case_local_basic
methods.description: Runs a test case for local onboarding, verifying configuration files and contents.

methods.name: run_case_remote_non_interactive
methods.description: Runs a test case for remote onboarding with a non-interactive approach, verifying the configuration.

methods.name: run_case_reset
methods.description: Runs a reset test case, verifying that configuration is cleared and reset appropriately.

methods.name: run_case_channels
methods.description: Runs the test case for configuring communication channels via wizard.

methods.name: run_case_skills
methods.description: Runs the test case for configuring skills via wizard.

methods.name: assert_log_not_contains
methods.description: Checks that a specific string does not appear in a log file.

methods.name: validate_local_basic_log
methods.description: Verifies that no unwanted messages appear in the local onboarding log.
